item.title: Corner Bakery Cafe offers deals for Croissant Day, one day only
item.description: Corner Bakery Cafe is celebrating National Croissant Day on January 30th with $4 specialty croissant sandwiches and $2 chocolate or classic round croissants at participating locations.

item.title: Another cold front to bring frigid temperatures to North Texas
item.description: Another cold front is expected to hit North Texas this weekend, bringing much colder temperatures and wind chills in the single digits, with a steady warm up to follow on Sunday.

item.title: Monster Jam makes a pit stop in North Texas
item.description: Northern Tool + Equipment is hosting a Monster Jam® event on Feb. 12 from 2:00 to 6:00 p.m. at 2630 W. Interstate 20 in Grand Prairie, Texas, offering families a chance to experience the excitement of a legendary Monster Jam® truck and receive a free certificate with a purchase of $100 or more.

item.title: Win a dream proposal in Irving-Las Colinas' romantic giveaway
item.description: Irving-Las Colinas is hosting a Dream Proposal Giveaway, offering one person a chance to propose in a romantic gondola cruise on the Mandalay Canal, with a stay at a premier hotel, after-party, photo shoot, and travel expenses covered.

item.title: Get a free berry acai bowl at Clean Juice on Feb. 9
item.description: Clean Juice is offering free Berry Acai Bowls on February 9, 2026.

item.title: Donate prom dresses for teens at Comerica Bank locations
item.description: Comerica Bank is holding its 11th annual North Texas Prom Dress Drive from February 2-28 to collect new or gently used formal dresses and accessories for local teens in need, with donations being accepted at seven designated banking locations across Texas.

item.title: Financial concerns prompt 74% of Americans to delay retirement
item.description: A new national survey reveals that 74% of Americans are likely to delay retirement due to financial concerns. The findings underscore how ongoing economic pressures are reshaping retirement timelines and long-term plans.

item.title: Enter Topgolf's sweepstakes to win a 2026 Honda CR-V hybrid
item.description: Topgolf is offering a chance to win a 2026 Honda CR-V TrailSport Hybrid for event planners who book events with 13 or more players between Jan. 29 and March 31, 2026.

item.title: Toastique opens in Dallas with limited‑time perks
item.description: Toastique, a gourmet toast, juice and coffee restaurant, is opening in Uptown Dallas on February 21st with a health-focused menu and special promotions during the opening week.

item.title: Breezy and cooler weather expected in Dallas-Fort Worth
item.description: Dallas-Fort Worth will experience breezy conditions this evening with temperatures continuing to drop overnight.
